newsitem.title: USA: First Union arranges Corrections Corp loan.
newsitem.headline: First Union arranges Corrections Corp loan.

text.p: First Union Capital Markets Corp said on Friday it has completed syndication of a $170-million revolving credit facility for Corrections Corp of America.

The credit facility, originally set for $125 million, was increased to $170 million as a result of a significant oversubscription by a syndicate that includes seven other financial institutions, First Union said.
Corrections Corp plans to use the three-year facility for working capital and general corporate purposes, First Union said.
